title: Learned Primal-Dual
core_mech: 同时学习 measurement-domain dual 与 image-domain primal 更新，并在每个 unrolled stage 显式调用 A 和 A*。
core_mech_en: Unrolls primal–dual proximal optimization into K stages of paired measurement-domain (dual) and image-domain (primal) residual CNNs calling A and A* at every stage.
input_desc: 测量 y、前向算子 A 与伴随算子 A*
input_en: Raw tomographic measurements y, forward projection operator A, and adjoint backprojection operator A*
output_desc: K 级展开后的图像域 primal 重建 x_hat
output_en: Reconstructed image x^{(K)} after K unrolled primal–dual iterations

adapter.name: Learned Primal-Dual
adapter.mechanism: Five-channel primal and dual memories update through distinct CNNs and explicit A and its exact transpose at every stage.
limitations: Three stages and a 16px parallel-beam phantom replace the full ODL experiment.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
